title: .notion/config.json
description: Persistent Notion workspace map for a repo. Written by /notion:bootstrap; consumed by /notion:publish, /notion:import, /notion:audit. Contains no secrets — MCP integration token lives in the MCP server connection, not here.

version.description: Config-file schema version. Bump when this file's shape changes (not when canonical Notion databases change — that's schema_version).

id.description: Notion page ID (UUID, with or without dashes).

ancestor_path.description: Human-readable workspace > team > page path. Recorded at bootstrap; used by /notion:audit to detect if the parent was moved.

databases.description: Canonical database map. Key is the canonical short name; value is the Notion identifiers needed for write/read calls.

data_source_id.description: Required for databases. Absent for the runbooks page (which is a page, not a database).

schema_version.description: Version of the canonical-database schema from notion-architect.md. Used to detect drift between workspace state and architect's current spec.

last_verified.description: Timestamp of most recent successful notion-fetch verification of every database. Refreshed by /notion:audit.
